name: GLiNER2
description: Zero-shot entity extraction, text classification, and structured data extraction using GLiNER2

extract_entities.name: Find named entities
extract_entities.description: Extract entities (people, places, organizations, dates, ...) that you define

labels.name: Entity types
labels.help: Comma-separated list of entity types to find, e.g. person, organization, location, date

autotag.name: Create tags
autotag.help: If checked, also tags the text with each entity found (e.g. Helsinki, Johan Virtanen), so files can be found and filtered by them. The entities are always browsable in the Tags view either way.

classify_text.name: Classify text
classify_text.description: Assign one or more categories you define to the text

labels.name: Categories
labels.help: Comma-separated list of categories to choose from, e.g. sports, politics, finance. Or pick existing tags below to reuse their descriptions and only ever tag with those.

multi_label.name: Allow multiple categories
multi_label.help: Check this if a text can belong to more than one category at once

extract_data.name: Extract structured data
extract_data.description: Pull the fields you name out of the text, e.g. invoice number, date and amount; shown as a table with one row per record found

fields.name: Fields to extract
fields.help: Comma-separated list of field names to extract, e.g. invoice_number, date, total_amount
